18769: The phantom sixth member of the "Generation of Miracles." He has a very weak presence and often seemingly appears out of nowhere as a result.
18770: Kagami was in America until second year of middle school and has recently come back to Japan in his first year of high school. He is determined to surpass "The Generation of Miracles" and become the number one.
21331: She is the coach of the basketball team. She has the ability to be able to tell the potential of each basketball player just by looking at their bodies. Her ability works best when the players are shirtless. She got this ability by following her father to work.
21332: Now a freshman at Kaijou High, Kise was the rookie of the "Generation of Miracles". Since he only started playing basketball in his second year of middle school, Kise was his team's least experienced member, and notes himself the weakest of the five.
22251: A Seirin sophomore who is known for being calm and composed. He also tends to make lame puns. His special ability is his Eagle Eye, which allows him to 'see' his selected area on the court without actually looking.
22252: A hard working player who has never spoken in front of his team members. For some reason, Koganei can understand what's on his mind and then speaks for him. Mitobe is the eldest son in a really big family, with a lot of brothers and sisters.
22253: Midorima often acts reserved, mean, and brusque with others, coming off as arrogant—although Takao claims Midorima is just "tsundere." He has a hard time acting kind to his opponents and generally hates "fooling around" (although Takao often pursues him into it).
22254: Sophomore and Seirin basketball club's captain. His specialty is 3 pointers, and can shoot accurately even if under extreme pressure. He's the team's clutch during tough situations.
22255: A Seirin sophomore. Considered a jack of all trades, master of none, Koganei is a fairly skilled all-rounder. This is driven home when his coach denotes his special skill as "being able to shoot from any point on the court, with a so-so accuracy rate"; a decidedly normal ability.
36309: This character page is set to represent and list all narrators, which haven't been given a visual representation of themselves in their respective work.
36820: Aomine was the ace of Teikou's team, embracing an aggressive and liquid style, made even more powerful by Kuroko's misdirection. In fact, Aomine was once Kuroko's "Light", before Kagami.
36821: The ex-manager of the basketball team at Teikou, and now serving as Touou's manager. She's in fact Aomine's childhood friend and enters Touou together with him because she can't leave him alone. She is actually in love with Kuroko and considers herself to be Kuroko's girlfriend.
36976: Formerly playing center for Teikou Middle School's basketball team, he does the same now for Yousen High School.
36977: One of the main players of the Yosen High basketball team, Himuro was the one who introduced and taught Kagami about basketball in the United States.
42038: The final member of the Generation of Miracles, he stood at their head as captain, leading their team to uncontested victory during the three years he played for Teikou Middle School.
42804: The captain of Kaijou's basketball team, Kasamatsu is a nationally credited point guard.
42805: The flirtatious, third-year Shooting Guard of the Kaijou team, Moriyama is a reliable player with a unique shooting form. He is quick to notice pretty women and often claims to fight for them on the court.
42806: A lively and excitable Kaijou High second-year, Hayakawa excels in offensive rebounds and is a ferocious Power Forward.
42807: Second-year regular and center of the Touou team, Wakamatsu is easily agitated and extremely loud. Being a player of notable stature, he performs commendably on the defensive, and scoops up rebounds with relative ease.
42808: A first-year regular of the Touou team, Sakurai is the team's Shooting Guard and 'Pre-Emptive Strike Leader'. Able to release the ball very quickly in the midst of a jump shot, opposing players find it almost impossible to effectively time a block to his shots.
42809: Touou High's captain and Point Guard, he is a well-spoken and superficially kind on first glance, but hides a somewhat darker personality that more subtly reveals itself in conversation.
45975: The progenitor of Seirin's basketball team and its ace, Kiyoshi is the last of the original Seirin team members to be introduced, due to a hospitalization for a knee injury he got during a game.
48943: Hanamiya "Bad Boy" Makoto is one of Kirisaki Daīchi High's players and an Uncrowned King. He is known for his foul and underhanded play and is the cause of Teppei's knee injury last year. Makoto has a great influence on his teammates.
48949: Taisuke Ootsubo is Shūtoku High's center and captain. Ootsubo is very large and muscular, so his position as a center under the goal is very secure. Usually, he takes rebounds and scores with dunks.
48951: Tomoki Tsugawa is a player of Seihou High. He is infamous for his pressure defense. Tsugawa has a shaven head, which has given him a lot of remarks. He has heavy eyebrows and is often seen with a smile on his face. He wears the Seihou uniform with the number 10.
48953: Tsutomu Iwamura is Seihou's center. After the Interhigh preliminaries, he and Kasuga quit the Seihou basketball team. Iwamura is one of the widest and biggest (not necessarily tallest) players seen in the series. He has short, spikey black hair.
48955: Daisuke Narumi is a first year rookie at Josei High. Narumi is a very tall and buff high school boy. He has spikey, dark hair that is combed to the back, with a few hairs sticking out at the front. He plays with jersey number 9.
48957: Kazuya Hara is a power forward at Kirisaki Daīchi High. Hara has long, messy blonde hair. His hair reaches over his eyes, covering them completely. He is always seen with chewing gum in his mouth, sometimes blowing a bell.
50833: Genta Takeuchi is the coach of Kaijou High.
53563: A freshman at Shuutoku High, Takao is much like Kuroko in that he is a passing expert. However, unlike Kuroko, Takao has none of Kuroko's invisibility.
53565: A Shuutoku regular. He dislikes Midorima's attitude and special status greatly; whenever Midorima makes an outlandish demand he frequently responds with a violent threat spoken with a rather eerie smile.
53567: A Shuutoku regular. He shares Miyaji's distaste for Midorima, and frequently offers support of the latter's violent proposals in an all-too serious manner, even providing realistic means for them to be accomplished.
53569: Katsunori Harasawa is the coach of Touou High.
53571: Masaaki Nakatani is the coach of Shūtoku High School. When Masaaki and Kagetora met at the Winter Cup, it is revealed that the two know each other. They share some mutual past, as they called each other Tora and Ma-Boy.
53573: Depsite being a small forward, Liu is an abnormally tall for a forward. He has a long face and thin eyebrows. He has light brown hair that covers his forehead in front and his neck at the back.
53575: Kensuke Fukui is Yousen's point guard and vice-captain. Fukui is generally a straightforward guy. He speaks his mind, often in a comedic manner. In game, he is a smart and usually calm player.
53577: Kenichi Okamura is Yousen High's power forward.
61171: He is a first year small forward at Seirin High. Kawahara is just as determined to win as the other players at Seirin. Even if he's just sitting on the bench he still cheers for the team.
61205: Riko's father. He is a sports trainer and a former Japanese national basketball team member, thus making him an expert when it comes to basketball. He's really fond of his daughter Riko, and declares that he will 'kill' anyone who dares to mess with her.
61751: Kouji Kobori is center and vice-captain of Kaijou High. Kobori is rather calm and prefers to stay out of the spotlight and trouble. He is focused and passionate. He can hold his own defensively against most centers and can score in the low post. He likes astronomical observation
62695: He is an exchange-student from Senegal and is over two meters long, towering over his teammates and opponents. Due to his extremely long build, he can block his opponents with no trouble. Due to him being an exchange student, he does not speak fluent Japanese.
62697: Yuusuke Tanimura is Shinkyo Academy's captain. When he heard about Seirin's win against Kaijo High from Hyuuga, he figured that the Generation of Miracles aren't such a big deal as he thought. He underestimates Seirin and therefore also the Generation of Miracles.
63327: Ryuuhei Kasuga is Seiho's guard. After the Interhigh preliminaries, he and Iwamura retired from the Seiho basketball team. Kasuga is a kind and controlled person, who keeps his head cool at all times. He is respectful towards his teammates and towards his opponents.
63941: Yukinori Matsumoto is Seihou High School's coach.
64093: Yoshinori Susa is a third year and the small forward of the Touo team. Susa's abilities have not been fully shown yet, but being a regular starter at Touo Academy, he is an elite player.
66205: Haizaki was a regular of Teiko Middle, before being replaced by Kise, Haizaki is very violent and ruthless, whether in real life or during basketball games. He was kicked out of the team by Akashi. When in Junior High school, his hair was longer, light gray and messy.
66805: Captain and the point guard of Fukuda Sougou Academy.
66809: Kotaro Hayama is one of the Uncrowned Kings. He is energetic and childish. Despite this, he is also arrogant as he always wants to destroy those who are up against him while also taking pride in being an upperclassmen.
66811: He is a regular of Rakuzan High and one of the Uncrowned Kings. He is nicknamed the Yaksha, which refers to a kind of nature spirit. Mibuchi was a very strong and talented player in Junior High school, but was overshadowed by the Generation of Miracles.
66813: Nebuya is a glutton who is shown to be able to eat comparable or even more than Kagami. Nebuya even overeats before a game with the thought that meat makes him strong. He is also quite rude and downsizes his opponents.
67129: Alex was a WNBA player who had to retire because of an eye disease. Later on, she taught basketball to Kagami and Tatsuya. However, Kagami went back to Japan, so Alex only finished training Tatsuya.
81845: Captain of Teikou's team during Kuroko's first year. Nijimura attended Teikou Junior High, and as a talented basketball player, became part of the first string and was even appointed captain sometime in his first two years on the team.
85337: A boy who taught Kuroko the basics of basketball after Kuroko became interested in the sport from watching matches on television. He was a regular member of the basketball team at Kamizaki Junior High before quitting.
149830: Tetsuya #2 is Tetsuya Kuroko's pet dog. He is taken care of by Kuroko and the Seirin team, and has become somewhat of the club's mascot. Kuroko also calls him #2.
196528: He is a member of the famous American street basketball team named Jabberwock which will go up against Kuroko, Kagami and the Generation of Miracles. He is the team's point guard and captain.
196529: Silver is said to be on a level that's beyond the Generation of Miracles. He won’t practice his techniques, nor build up his muscles. He uses his natural talent, such as his height and superior strength, to overpower opposing players and dominate the court.
215047: Koujirou Furuhashi is a small forward at Kirisaki Daiichi High.
215048: Mayuzumi Chihiro is a regular member in Rakuzan High. On court, he wears the blue and white Rakuzan jersey with the number 5. Mayuzumi was introduced during match of the semi-finals against Shuuūtoku at the Winter Cup in a very vague fashion.
215049: Naoto Sanada is the former first string coach of Teikou Junior High during the Generation of Miracles' first and second years. He replaces Kouzou Shirogane as head coach after the latter fell ill.
215050: Tomoya Inoue was a regular member and the ace of Basketball Club Team in Kamizaki Junior High. He is Aomine's ex-rival.
215051: Yuuya Miyaji is a second-year regular at Shuutoku High and the new captain after Ootsubo. He is the younger brother of Kiyoshi Miyaji.
215052: Kentarou Seto is a center at Kirisaki Daiichi High.
215053: Takuma Ootsuka is the captain and shooting guard of Nakamiya South High.
215054: Eiji Shirogane is the coach of Rakuzan High. In his 40s, Shirogane is among the older coaches shown in the series and his age is apparent in his face. He has clean, black and straight swept-back hair and dresses in a black business suit; a white shirt and red tie.
215055: Hiroshi Yamazaki is a shooting guard at Kirisaki Daiichi High.
215056: He is the adviser of Seirin High's Basketball Club
215057: Kouzou Shirogane is the former head coach of Teikou Junior High. He coached the well-renowned Generation of Miracles during their first and second years. He is replaced by Sanada after falling ill.
215058: Reiji Mochida was the captain and regular player who used to play for Meikou Junior High with Shigehiro Ogiwara.
215059: Shinya Nakamura is a 2nd year shooting guard at Kaijou High. Nakamura is a passionate player who is seen cheering his team-mates from the bench fervently. He wears the blue and white Kaijou jersey with the number 9.
215060: The hot-headed older sister of Shinji Koganei. She's shown to be frequently exasperated by Shinji's lack of commitment, and alongside Mitobe encourages him to keep playing basketball.
273799: Coach of Yousen High School. A smart tactician, she uses a shinai to keep her players in line.
